fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create ONE finished square 1:1 watercolor narrative illustration for an adult Persian book about keeping friends from different generations. Two wide scenes are stacked vertically: the upper scene is a young adult's life, the lower scene is decades later. Show warmth, companionship and shared joy rather than a lesson caption. Narrow white paper gap between scenes, irregular painted scene edges and generous white outer margins.

IDENTITY AND AGE
YELLOW is the SAME central person in both scenes, with the same warm yellow color, medium neutral adult body, perfectly circular head, small minimal facial design and a few very short fine upper-outer eyelashes. Upper yellow is a young ADULT, without glasses or wrinkles. Lower yellow is older, wearing simple round glasses, two or three fine outer-eye wrinkles and only a very slight natural forward shoulder bend. The body remains neutral, not feminized or distorted.
The upper friend is an OLDER PURPLE adult with simple round glasses, a few fine eye wrinkles and slightly forward relaxed shoulders. Purple smiles with small happy curved closed-eye marks inside the glasses.
The lower friend is a YOUNG GREEN adult with modest dark oval eyes and a warm smile. No clothes or accessories for any figure other than glasses on the elders. All are adult-sized, capable, equal friends; no child, dependent elder or caregiver story.

UPPER SCENE: A FRIEND AT THE DOOR
A modest warm home's open wooden front door. Young yellow stands just inside the threshold on a woven brown doormat and welcomes older purple with delighted surprise. Yellow has a small open smile, one hand lightly near the chest and the other lifted in greeting.
Older purple stands outside facing yellow and carries a small ROUND BROWN LAYER CAKE with pale cream icing on a round tray. THREE slender colored lit candles are on this cake. Hands support the tray naturally and the entire cake, tray, full bodies and both feet fit inside the scene.
The setting has a simple stone step and low garden wall, one terracotta pot of modest white flowers near the doorway, a small wall lantern and restrained green garden foliage. Bright friendly daylight.
A small cream paper-like heading toward the upper-left reads exactly:
"جوانی"
A white speech bubble with tail clearly leading to PURPLE reads exactly:
"تولدت مبارک، رفیق!"
The friendship, friendly visit and shared birthday joy are central, without extra people or gifts.

LOWER SCENE: NEW SURROUNDINGS, SAME PERSON, A YOUNGER FRIEND
DECADES LATER. The same yellow person is now older and stands with a happy grateful expression in a genuinely DIFFERENT living room. Yellow's round glasses and fine wrinkles clarify age; the barely slight forward shoulder bend must not distort the circular head or neutral body. One hand rests lightly near the own chest, the other hangs naturally.
Young green stands to the right facing older yellow and offers a genuinely DIFFERENT cake: a low OBLONG LIGHT CREAM FRUIT CAKE topped with a few strawberries and blueberries, ONE small red-striped lit candle, on a simple oval/round grey tray. The shape, decoration and number of candles are clearly different from the upper brown round cake.
The room has a pale blue-glazed window with light curtains on the left, a blue armchair with a small coral cushion, a simple side stool with a couple of books, a restrained landscape picture, a warm rug, a wooden side cabinet with a small lamp and a quiet bookcase toward the right. A little greenery is enough. Do NOT repeat the upper doorway, lantern, doormat, garden composition or same cake. Identity stays fixed while life and surroundings change.
The heading toward the upper-left of this lower scene reads exactly:
"سال‌ها بعد"
A white speech bubble with its tail leading to GREEN reads exactly:
"تولدت مبارک، رفیق!"
Both complete adult bodies, both feet, tray and cake remain visible and inside the scene. No additional characters, extra narrative panels, explanatory text, age numbers or moral symbols.

For happy closed eyes, use small simple dark curved marks without any white eyeball; when eyes are open, use the modest dark oval design described below. A few very short lashes remain delicate and never become doll-like.

STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN
Use authentic moderate hand-painted layered watercolor on luminous textured white paper. Broad softly irregular overlapping translucent washes are visible inside heads, torsos, arms, hands and legs, as well as the scenery, with varied pigment density and subtle local pooling. Colors are warm and clear with restrained soft shading. Preserve a natural painterly finish, not flat/vector coloring, marker, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D, repetitive embossed texture, heavy mottling or decorative splashes.
Every head is a PERFECT CIRCLE with equal width and height, an uninterrupted circular contour, no oval, chin, jaw, flattened lower arc, ears, hair or nose. Head joins shoulders directly WITHOUT A NECK. A soft darker crescent of the same local body hue beneath the head separates it from the upper torso without creating a neck segment.
All bodies have balanced medium adult proportions, neither plump/chibi nor spindly or excessively stretched. All genders use the same simple neutral structure: gently almost-parallel torso sides, natural unshaped pelvis, coherent limbs and naturally aligned legs. No breasts, tiny waist, waist notch, projected hips, separate buttock bulge or gendered contours. Fine short upper-outer eyelashes, where specified, are the principal female cue and must not change the eye design.
Eyes are modest small dark ovals with an optional TINY light glint INSIDE, never white sclera surrounding a pupil or large doll eyes. Simple eyebrows and small expressive mouths. No sharp flat pink circular cheek spots; blush is absent or only barely perceptible diffuse translucent watercolor.
Each openly visible hand has exactly THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural gripping or folded-finger occlusion allowed. Body contours use darker versions of the SAME LOCAL BODY COLOR, not black; facial details and Persian letters may be dark.
Full figures, feet and important objects stay within scene boundaries; natural furniture/boat/prop occlusion is allowed but no body part or object is cut by file or panel edges. Clear irregular watercolor boundaries, generous CLEAN WHITE PAPER outer margins, narrow white gutters, no heavy panel borders. Polished thoughtful adult-book art, warm, kind, quietly witty and family friendly.
All in-image writing is ONLY the short verbatim Persian text specified for that scene, with accurate connected letters and right-to-left direction. No English, extra captions, numbers, watermark or signature. The pictured actions communicate the idea without an explanatory moral caption.
